name: USD CoinVertible
oneLiner: USDCV is Societe Generale-FORGE's MiCA-regulated U.S. dollar stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 against cash and HQLA segregated at BNY Mellon.
collateral: U.S. dollar cash deposits and high-quality liquid assets held 1:1 in segregated accounts at Bank of New York Mellon (BNY), managed by independent fiduciaries and bankruptcy-remote from SG-FORGE; daily public disclosure of reserve composition

genius.notes: MiCA authorization and SG-FORGE reserve/redemption disclosures do not establish a public U.S. GENIUS permitted-issuer approval or registered foreign-issuer exception. SG-FORGE actively restricts US persons from holding USDCV (Regulation S offshore-transaction carve-out only). The GENIUS Act foreign-issuer exception requires a Treasury MiCA-comparability determination plus OCC registration — a pathway still in proposed-rulemaking as of 2026-06-18 with no determination issued. No public indication SG-FORGE has initiated or intends to initiate that process.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific U.S. GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application, foreign-exception determination, or comparability finding was located for USDCV or SG-FORGE. SG-FORGE actively restricts US persons and has not announced intent to seek US market access under GENIUS. The foreign-exception framework itself remains in proposed-rulemaking.

mintAuthority.summary: USDCV Ethereum mint is gated by the registrar EOA (0x7de0bb…da69) immutable in the shared SmartCoin V4 implementation (same as EURCV); no proxy admin; Solana deployment is issuer-controlled and not separately scored.

controls.label: SG-FORGE issuance backend
controls.evidence: Per SG-FORGE materials, onboarded institutional investors buy USDCV 1:1 by sending USD to SG-FORGE's bank account; SG-FORGE mints tokens to investor wallet. On-chain, the registrar EOA (immutable) is the sole minter. Issuer-backend model corroborated: all role holders are SG-FORGE-operated EOAs.

controls.label: USDCV Ethereum token proxy (SmartCoin V4)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294784: EIP-1967 impl = 0xf4ccc80c4b831a0d8d1414f2aca82a3d760ff05b (same SmartCoin V4 as EURCV); proxy admin slot = zero. Immutable operators from implementation bytecode (PUSH32 scan): registrar (minter) = 0x7de0bbdfcd4a6a956f149befcca30d6b5bc5da69 (EOA), operations = 0xc98cb9f53e20afbbeb75caf6456ed52d5d7903f6 (EOA), technical (upgrade admin) = 0x54124a6834af252a0f9ac7f478001aa500428955 (EOA). All confirmed as EOAs via eth_getCode.

controls.label: USDCV SmartCoin technical upgrade EOA
controls.evidence: The verified SmartCoin V4 implementation exposes proxiableUUID(), upgradeTo(), and upgradeToAndCall(), and gates _authorizeUpgrade to the technical operator. At Ethereum block 25530874, technical() returned 0x54124a6834af252a0f9ac7f478001aa500428955; eth_getCode at that block returned no bytecode. The proxy's EIP-1967 admin slot is zero, so this EOA is the UUPS upgrade authority rather than a ProxyAdmin contract.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294784: USDCV and EURCV share implementation 0xf4ccc80c4b831a0d8d1414f2aca82a3d760ff05b (SmartCoin V4, UUPS). Proxy admin slot zero. Immutable operators extracted from bytecode: registrar/minter EOA 0x7de0bbdfcd4a6a956f149befcca30d6b5bc5da69, operations EOA 0xc98cb9f53e20afbbeb75caf6456ed52d5d7903f6, technical/upgrade EOA 0x54124a6834af252a0f9ac7f478001aa500428955. All EOAs confirmed. On-chain model corroborates SG-FORGE issuer-backend description. SG-FORGE publishes issuer-reported reserve composition and valuation daily, with the latest observed snapshot dated July 11, 2026, but challenge searches found no recurring independent USDCV assets-and-liabilities reconciliation or qualifying attestor. Reconciliation is therefore unknown. SG-FORGE's issuer disclosure identifies Société Générale-FORGE as the USDCV issuer and as an ACPR-authorized Electronic Money Institution; the ACPR register is the competent prudential registry, supporting prudential supervision of the same legal entity.
